videos.title: Bombay Waterfront
videos.description: 1952. Directed by Maclean Rogers and starring John Bentley, Patricia Dainton and Peter Gawthorne. Follows Temple's efforts to aid the police in solving a series of gruesome murders.

videos.title: Serena
videos.description: 1962. Drama. Directed by Peter Maxwell. Stars Patrick Holt, Emrys Jones & Honor Blackman. An inspector strives to solve the mystery of an artist's dead wife. The artist becomes the main suspect.

videos.title: William Tell
videos.description: 1959. Stars: Conrad Phillips, Willoughby Goddard & Jennifer Jayne. Trapped on an island owned by Prince Erik, a man who enjoys hunting prey, Tell's careers appears to be at the end.

videos.title: Object Z
videos.description: 1965. Stars Margaret Neale, Denys Peek & Trevor Bannister. Scientists around the world announce that a meteor will hit Earth in six weeks.

videos.title: William at the Circus
videos.description: Episode 1. 1948. Stars William Graham, Garry Marsh & Jane Welsh. William Brown begins to devise a plan to secure more pay and shorter hours for schoolboys.

videos.title: Venture Adventure
videos.description: 1941. A short film encouraging young men to enlist in the Army Training Corps, which was set up to train men in aviation skills, navigation and general duties for entry into the RAF.

videos.title: Hawkeye & the Last of the Mohicans
videos.description: 1957. Directed by Sam Newfield. Stars John Hart, Lon Chaney Jr & Bill Walsh. A series of thefts are falsely attributed to the innocent.

videos.title: The Lone Ranger
videos.description: 1949. Stars: Clayton Moore, Jay Silverheels & Sheila Ryan. Pete and Pedro don't like working, until the Lone Ranger persuades them to help an attractive young woman save her ranch.

videos.title: Supercar
videos.description: 1961. Stars David Graham, George Murcell & Graydon Gould. On the way to the South Pole, an uncontrolled force lands them on a strange island where they are in danger.

videos.title: The Adventures of Robin Hood
videos.description: 1957. Stars Richard Greene, Alexander Gauge & Hugh McDermott. King Richard sends Robin Hood and Friar Tuck on a mission to Scotland to collect a debt in the form of gold.

videos.title: Target Earth
videos.description: 1954. Sci-Fi. Directed by Sherman A. Rose. Starring Richard Denning. A large city is ordered to be completely evacuated as an army of robots, believed to be from the planet Venus, attack it.

videos.title: Gift Horse
videos.description: 1952. Director: Compton Bennett. Stars Trevor Howard, Richard Attenborough, Sonny Tufts. In 1940, the Captain of an old Royal Navy destroyer struggles with his crew, as well as the Nazis.

videos.title: Scales of Justice
videos.description: The Material Witness. Stars Edgar Lustgarten & John Carlin. A young executive plots to replace a firm's manager, and turns him in to police as a drunk driver. (S1, E.

videos.title: Call Northside 777
videos.description: 1948. Drama. Directed by Henry Hathaway. Stars James Stewart, Richard Conte & Helen Walker. A Chicago reporter looks into an old murder and realises the man jailed for the crime is innocent.

videos.title: Dick Turpin
videos.description: 1982. Stars Richard O'Sullivan & Ken Wynne. Swiftnick helps two lads who have been tricked into joining the King's army. The recruiting officers double back to get revenge.

videos.title: Maigret
videos.description: 1961. Stars Rupert Davies, Ewen Solon & Joseph Furst. Maigret travels to a coastal village to investigate the murder of the postmistress, with the schoolmaster being the main suspect.

videos.title: Lillie
videos.description: 1978. Stars Francesca Annis, Denis Lill & Ann Firbank. As Lillie acquires more admirers, her old friends see less of her, and she begins planning for the end of the season.

videos.title: Unfaithfully Yours
videos.description: 1984. Comedy. Directed by Howard Zieff. Stars Dudley Moore, Nastassja Kinski & Armand Assante. An orchestra conductor believes that his wife is cheating on him and concocts a plan to murder her.

videos.title: Confessions from a Holiday Camp
videos.description: 1977. Comedy. Directed by Norman Cohen. Stars Anthony Booth, Robin Askwith & Bill Maynard. Holiday camp employees enjoy their summer celebrations until a new manager arrives to spoil the fun.

videos.title: EuroTrash
videos.description: Hosted by Antoine de Caunes. We meet a Spanish siren with castanets, meet Finland's biggest slappers, Lolo dives deep down with her snorkel and one man goes down in medical history.

videos.title: Yanky Panky
videos.description: Join country music persona Tina C as she uncovers the eccentric subcultures, bizarre personalities, and the rude, crude and lewd underbelly of American society.

videos.title: The Hitch-Hiker
videos.description: 1953. Thriller. Director Ida Lupino. Stars Edmond O'Brien, Frank Lovejoy & William Talman. Ray & Gilbert's fishing trip takes a turn when they pick up a hitch-hiker who turns out to be on the run.

videos.title: The Day Time Ended
videos.description: 1979. Sci-Fi. Director: John Cardos. Stars Jim Davis, Christopher Mitchum & Dorothy Malone. Aliens visit the house of a family. The house is sucked into a time warp that sends it back in time.

videos.title: One Step Beyond
videos.description: Stars Philip Bourneuf & Anna Lee. After a young girl recovers from scarlet fever, she rejects her parents and insists she is the recently deceased daughter of another family.

videos.title: Down Among The Z Men
videos.description: 1952. Comedy directed by Maclean Rogers and starring Michael Bentine, Harry Secombe, Spike Milligan and Peter Sellers. Prof. Pureheart loses a secret formula in the grocery shop.

videos.title: Scotland Yard
videos.description: The Unseeing Eye. Directed by Geoffrey Muller. Starring Russell Napier, John Stone and Denny Dayviss. A night worker returning home sees smoke and flames coming from a building. (S1, E.

videos.title: Sherlock Holmes
videos.description: The Case of the Split Ticket. 1954. Starring: Ronald Howard, Howard Marion-Crawford & Archie Duncan. When O'Casey wins the lottery, they must find Albert before the ticket runs out.

videos.title: The Brave Don't Cry
videos.description: 1952. Drama. Directed by Philip Leacock. Starring John Gregson, Meg Buchanan & John Rae. Based on a true story. In a small Scots mining-town, a mine cave-in seals the entire crew.

videos.title: X The Unknown
videos.description: 1956. Fantasy. Directed by Leslie Norman. Stars Dean Jagger, Edward Chapman & Leo McKern. A radioactive creature terrorises a remote Scottish village, will anyone be able to stop it.

videos.title: North West Frontier
videos.description: 1959. Drama. Director: J. Lee Thompson. Stars Kenneth More, Lauren Bacall & Herbert Lom. In British India, a prince must be taken to safety across a rebel-held territory.

videos.title: Water World
videos.description: 2000. Actor and canal enthusiast Timothy West narrates the story of the incredible engineering feats needed to build canals and meets some of the characters to be found on inland waterways today.

videos.title: That's My Boy
videos.description: 1985. Stars Mollie Sugden, Deddie Davies & Eric Francis. Ida drops hints about what she wants for her upcoming birthday, but when it arrives she ends up disappointed.

videos.title: For the Love of Ada
videos.description: Stars: Wilfred Pickles, Irene Handl & Jack Smethurst. Ada is about to become a grandmother but when Ruth's baby arrives, Leslie is at first nowhere to be found. (S4, E.

videos.title: The Man from U.N.C.L.E
videos.description: 1966. Stars Robert Vaughn, David McCallum & Larry Blyden. THRUSH has a mole inside New York headquarters. Solo and Kuryakin are assigned to root out the double agent.

videos.title: The Footage Detectives
videos.description: This week's first stop is Piccadilly Roundabout in 1944 wartime London, there's a slice of history from a bread factory in 1966, a reel of 1950s Italy and a look at the history of Baxter's.

videos.title: Enemy At The Door
videos.description: 1978. Stars: Alfred Burke, Bernard Horsfall. Dr. Martel arranges hospitalisation for frail old Mrs. Bree who, with her son Edward, are rent-free tenants of Peter.

videos.title: Jigsaw
videos.description: 1962. Directed by Val Guest and starring Jack Warner. A woman is murdered and it's up to Detective Fellows to sift through the clues and solve the 'Jigsaw'. Great shots of Brighton in the 60s.

videos.title: Fox
videos.description: 1980. Stars Bernard Hill, Mary Peach & Lee Walker. Vin tries to sort out his finances so he can buy a country pub. Ray is also offered a good business proposition.

videos.title: An Innocent Man
videos.description: 1989. Crime Drama. Directed by Peter Yates. Stars Tom Selleck, F. Murray Abraham & Laila Robins. Two corrupt cops send an innocent man to prison, leading him to seek revenge on his release.

videos.title: The Heritage Chart Show with Mike Read
videos.description: A TOTP style TV Show for Heritage Artists based on the Heritage Chart which is voted on in over 80 countries. Songs you love from popular artists, live and on video with the odd interview.

videos.title: Play of the Month: Robinson Crusoe
videos.description: 1974. Drama. Director: James MacTaggart. Stars Stanley Baker, Ram John Holder & Jerome Willis. A man struggles to survive after being shipwrecked on a deserted island.

videos.title: Three Silent Men
videos.description: 1940. Crime. An inventor of a deadly weapon to be used against the allies is injured in a crash. Surgeon, Sir James (Sebastian Shaw) saves his life but learns of his plot. Stars Derrick De Marney.

videos.title: The Adventures of Robin Hood
videos.description: 1956. Stars Richard Greene, Bill Owen & John Dearth. After the sheriff's brother is killed, the man responsible is taken in by Robin, but tensions soon rise as he struggles to fit in.

videos.title: Supercar
videos.description: 1961. Stars David Graham, George Murcell & Graydon Gould. On the way to the South Pole, an uncontrolled force lands them on a strange island where they are in danger.

videos.title: The Vise
videos.description: 1955. Stars Ron Randell, Peter Grant & Jan Holden. Bert Edwards receives a trunk full of Persian rugs. Soon after the luggage turns up at Euston Station with a body inside.

videos.title: The Detectives
videos.description: Captain Matt Holbrook (Robert Taylor) leads a squad of brave and tough detectives tackling crime. Also Stars: Tige Andrews, Russell Thorson, Adam West.

videos.title: The Great Van Robbery
videos.description: 1959. Crime Drama. Director: Max Varnel. Stars Denis Shaw, Kay Callard & Tony Quinn. An Interpol detective pursues a dangerous thief who has placed his loot into a bank account in Rio de Janeiro.

videos.title: Morocco
videos.description: 1930. Romance. Director: Josef von Sternberg. Stars Gary Cooper, Marlene Dietrich & Adolphe Menjou. A night club singer and a Legionnaire fall in love, but their relationship becomes complicated.

videos.title: Salvage with a Smile 1940
videos.description: 1940. Second World War comedy short explaining the value of salvage with Kathleen Harrison and Ronald Shiner, made at Ealing Studios.

videos.title: Z-Cars
videos.description: 1976. Stars Ray Lonnen, Albert Welling & John Cording. Armed robbery is becoming almost a daily event and soon someone will get hurt. What happens if the police meet violence with violence.

videos.title: Della
videos.description: 1964. Drama. Director: Robert Gist and starring Joan Crawford. Della (Crawford), a reclusive matriarch of Royal Bay, watches over the affluent coastal town. Possession, for her, is everything.

videos.title: Banking a Banana
videos.description: 1961. A previously lost comedy short, starring Spike Milligan, about using bananas as a form of currency.

videos.title: Richard the Lionheart
videos.description: 1963. Stars Dermot Walsh, Nigel Green & Robin Hunter. A charlatan posing as a monk is going through towns selling indulgences, bearing a forged document from the king.

videos.title: Send For Paul Temple
videos.description: 1946. Crime Drama. Directed by John Argyle. Starring Anthony Hulme and Joy Shelton. Scotland Yard calls in novelist and amateur detective Paul Temple to help track down a gang of diamond robbers.

videos.title: Film Noir
videos.description: 2022. The origins of Film Noir begin with the industrial revolution and with the ideas that that form of mechanised production produces.

videos.title: Blithe Spirit
videos.description: 1945. Comedy. Director: David Lean. Stars Rex Harrison, Constance Cummings, Kay Hammond, Margaret Rutherford. A newly-married writer and his second wife are haunted by the ghost of his first wife.

videos.title: Look At Life A Flight of Fancy
videos.description: 1961. How does a homing pigeon 'home'? This film takes a look at the development of the birds, from fledglings to long-distance champions.

videos.title: Scales of Justice
videos.description: The Material Witness. Stars Edgar Lustgarten & John Carlin. A young executive plots to replace a firm's manager, and turns him in to police as a drunk driver. (S1, E.

videos.title: The Footage Detectives
videos.description: Mike and Noel step back to 1947 with warnings for curious children, then it's off to Sweden for a little nostalgia from 1957 and the detectives talk fireworks 50s style and explosive escapades.

videos.title: Maigret
videos.description: 1997. Stars Bruno Cremer, Nade Dieu & Jacques Boudet. Maigret travels to a small town in Belgium to help a friend whose brother-in-law has been accused of murder.

videos.title: Adventures of a Plumber's Mate
videos.description: 1978. Comedy. Director: Stanley Long. Stars Chris Neil, Christopher Biggins, Lindy Benson. Plumber's mate Sid meets ladies at work. Susie is unaware of his dalliances as he gets into debt trouble.

videos.title: Murders In...
videos.description: Murders in Martinique - Meurtres en Martinique. 2016. Director: Philippe Niang. Stars Sara Martins & Olivier Marchal. Parisian forensic specialist helps in an investigation near Mount Pelée.
